semiconductor_relevance: High — SEMES is a leading manufacturer of semiconductor and display equipment, providing essential tools for the production process.
summary: SEMES Co., Ltd. is the largest Korean manufacturer of semiconductor and display equipment, generating approximately $2 billion in revenue. The company offers a comprehensive range of equipment for both Front End and Back End processes, including die bonders, probe stations, and various cleaning and etching solutions.

regional_presence.Korea: SEMES is the largest equipment manufacturer in Korea, focusing on high-end technology and continuous R&D investments.
